SELECT payment_type,
       count(*)              AS trips,
       sum(total_amount)     AS revenue,
       avg(trip_distance)    AS avg_distance
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2019-12-01 00:00:00'
  AND pickup_datetime <  '2020-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY revenue DESC
